niche: AI for real estate agencies in Ghana: turning listing photos into premium, cinematic short videos (no filming) plus captions and posting, so listings get more enquiries
audience: Owners and managers of real estate agencies in Ghana (mostly Accra: East Legon, Cantonments, Airport Residential; also Kumasi and other cities), independent agents and property developers. Some of their buyers are diaspora Ghanaians abroad.
goals: Get agencies to comment LISTING for the free Listing Enquiry Playbook, build trust by teaching useful things, and start sales conversations for the done-for-you listing video service
call_to_action: Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook
offer: Done-for-you: we turn a listing's photos into premium, cinematic short videos made with AI (no filming needed), write the captions and post across their platforms. Also a free listing review on WhatsApp. Later services, mention lightly only: a WhatsApp/Instagram AI assistant that replies to enquiries instantly, an AI receptionist, workflow automation.
brand_statement: We turn your listing photos into premium videos that get more enquiries.
contrarian_belief: You don't need more listings. You need the ones you have to get noticed. The fix isn't more money on ads, it's packaging the same listing so it gets noticed, understood and acted on.
voice: First person singular: 'I' (the founder speaking). Simple English at about an eighth-grade reading level. Short sentences. Confident and helpful, never hype. Talk directly to the agent as 'you'.
content_pillars: Listing mistakes and fixes (e.g. 5 reasons your listing gets no DMs)
How-tos from the playbook: photos, the 15-second video formula, the 5-line caption formula
Before and after: a plain photo-dump post vs a premium version
Speed and replies: why slow WhatsApp replies lose buyers
AI for real estate, explained simply, and myth-busting for doubters
Agency growth: getting listings noticed, diaspora buyers, consistency
Offer posts (about 1 in 10): the done-for-you service or the free listing review
content_rules: No made-up statistics, results or testimonials. Only use numbers from the content bank or the playbook. Clearly hypothetical examples are fine ('say you get 20 messages a week').
Never promise a guaranteed number of enquiries, viewings or sales.
Never put prices on carousels or captions. For value framing use comparisons like 'one extra rental a month covers it'.
No on-screen text saying content is AI-generated. Never show or describe unrealistic houses.
Speak to Ghanaian agents: cedis (GH₵), Ghanaian areas (East Legon, Cantonments, Airport Residential, Spintex, Kumasi), WhatsApp and WhatsApp Status, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, property sites.
One idea per slide. Strong hook on slide 1. A clear takeaway. The last slide has ONE call to action.
Default call to action: 'Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook'. Use exactly the keyword LISTING. Occasionally 'Save this' or 'DM me' instead, never more than one action.
About 9 helpful carousels for every 1 that sells.
topics_to_avoid: Prices or package names with prices
AI hype or 'AI will replace agents'
tagline: AI Automation · Intelligent Workflow · Real Results
